svg.title: Run length is the first filter for choosing a deployment shape, and the queue-plus-worker default covers the middle of that range.
svg.desc: Five run-length bands set the first filter for a deployment shape: under 30 seconds and idempotent uses a request-lifecycle SDK; 30 seconds to 60 minutes uses a queue, worker, and checkpoint database — the default for most teams; 60 minutes to 24 hours uses the same queue and worker, or a Cloud Run Job; more than 24 hours that must survive deploys uses a durable workflow engine; multi-day reinforcement-learning training loops use a Kubernetes Job with a volume and Temporal.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Read shape 2 first — it's the default for most teams and the skeleton the others vary.
